name: Rock Carvings in Tanum
description: Scattered across smooth granite slabs in northern Bohuslän, on Sweden's west coast, these Bronze Age carvings show ships, warriors, animals, weapons and human figures pecked into the rock thousands of years ago. Their sheer number and fine quality set them apart, and together they offer a vivid glimpse of daily life and beliefs in prehistoric Europe. Many can be seen in the open landscape near Tanumshede.
